In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
I possess many traits that make me a leader and a strong student. Firstly, I am very calm. This adds to my leadership skills by helping me keep a level head during times of stress when others are not so calm. It helps me make good decisions to help others and myself. An example of this is when I work in a group in class and my team doesn't collaborate well and easily get off task. I had to be calm and assign roles so that we could finish our work. I will frequently check in on them to make sure they are staying focused because my work and my grades are important to me and I have to do what I need to do to make sure they stay high. Another trait I have is empathy. Being empathetic helps me understand my peers and others around me. As an immigrant, I have experienced a lot of hardships at a young age. These experiences add to my good qualities because it allows me to understand and empathize with people who are different or struggling. Finally, I am a hard worker. I never give up until I have accomplished something that I want to accomplish. This helps me be a strong student because it shows that I'm always focused, I am disciplined and I have academic success. One example of this is when I moved to the US at the age of fourteen, I did not know English. However, all of my classes were taught to me in English. I was determined to pass all of my classes with high scores and to master a new language. This was extremely difficult, but I stayed focused and prioritized my time to achieve my goals. I knew when I needed to ask for help and stay after school, even when my friends went to the park for ice cream. Because of this trait, I now am a high honor roll student with a strong GPA who is bilingual.

In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
Immigrant and first-generation American students have opportunities to receive school orientation counseling to learn more about university and the opportunities they can have in college. They have access to mentoring programs that will guide them in the process of going to college and discovering their careers. They also have opportunities to enter programs to earn university credits and receive guidance from university personnel about scholarships or things they should do before entering college. Financial support is another thing they can receive to cover their studies, such as scholarships or loans so they can fulfill their dreams of having a career. Many programs also offer language service support so that they can improve their English and feel more comfortable learning for their classes.

In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
What makes me a strong leader is my responsibility and my time management skills. For example, when we get homework as soon as get home after I do a couple of basic things I need to do I do my homework and I always try my best on it always. My time manage skills also make me a strong student because on everything I do I get on time. For instance, when I need to go to doctor appointments I always get there way earlier because it is just a habit. In addition when school starts in the morning at 8:35 I?m always one of the first in the classroom along with around 2-3 other kids. Also so far this year I have 0 latenesses which is demonstrating how I get to manage my time. Another thing that makes me a strong leader is keeping everyone on task even when we don?t understand the topic. What I mean by this is that I be asking the people in my group questions on the thing we are learning that will get them more involved so we could finish the work faster. This keeps us on task and going on the work instead of being distracted by something else. Something that makes me a strong student also is the ideas I bring to a certain group when I join them. Often when I?m in groups people rely on me to have the ?smartest? ideas just because over the years I?ve had a pretty good gpa. What this has helped me develop is coming up with more ideas quicker than I used to and contribute more to my group.

Speakhire can help me boost my academic profile because since I?m getting to meet people who are doing the job that I?m interested in I can kinda see how the career path is like and if it is all of what I though. Also by just doing this like it motivates me to learn way more things that I?ve never though about before. It can help me develop new ways of thinking about things and maybe even new techniques that I?ve never though of before.

Young people who are immigrants and first generation American have to be aware of that any career opportunities that is possible to get they should get it because it?s going to help on the long run and even give you things like internships, scholarships, and easier access to jobs. With all this the career the person desires becomes much easier because of all the resources available to them now.

As a speakhire student, I would succeed because I believe that I have the capabilities to manage my work at school and the other things speakhire wants me to do like the meetings with the champions. Monday through Friday I have Math, Spanish, Crew, gym/college readiness, lunch, chemistry, ap seminar (classes from 8:35-3:25). For example, having access to a variety of different opportunities will allow me to find what I truly excel in while also gaining information from other fields of work for future reference. As a Junior I have little to no experience in working fields which is why I hope to use SPEAKHIRE as compensation for that. As I become older my past experiences will need to be added to my resume/transcript when applying for jobs/universities etc. thus giving me all the more reason to apply for this program.

The opportunities that young people, who are immigrant and first-generation Americans currently need to gain awareness of career opportunities are career programs, like SPEAKHIRE and Work Based Learning and other programs related to career pathways, experience and developing a community of peers and professionals.

column299: In order to develop our linguistic and social abilities, we must hold meetings between different people in order to gain experience from each other. Hello, my name is Rashid Abdullah, and I think it is important for me to enroll in this speakhire program so that I can develop my language skills. It is also important for me to join this educational program so that I can communicate with others and understand them in the right way. I have to join this educational program to get good training in order to develop my language skills and develop my ability to communicate well with others. Talking with people who speak English helps to master the language better. When I talk to my classmates or teachers, I can learn a language faster than just reading and writing. Also, when I watch videos to learn English, I learn at a much lower quality than when I learn the language by talking to my colleagues, teachers, or even my other friends. Learning the language through conversations with others is better than learning the language from other sources, so it is better to get the opportunity to talk to other people frequently. Meeting with others improves my social contact with others and strengthens the social bonds between us. For example, sometimes I can't understand a person, but when I talk to him, it improves our communication and we understand easily. Also when I came to the USA for the first time I had no friends in school and it was difficult but after a short time we were talking and helping each other so that Friendship bonds arose between us. After talking to that person who was born among us, he continued to make our work easier. Also, talking with others made me make new friends, which contributed to strengthening my ties to the community. This means that when I participate in this program, it is likely that this will contribute to improving my communication with the community and strengthening my social ties. I think that joining this educational program is necessary and important to build my language and social skills as well. In this way, I will most likely work hard to acquire the skills I need to build my educational future. Ambassador Responses:
11
In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
My name is Lhianna Capell. Three traits that make me who I am and an effective leader are competence, determination, and integrity. To make an efficient and capable leader, the leader must be competent and able to take on responsibilities and work. Competence is the capacity to do something successfully. This is important because competence demonstrates how a leader is able to set aside time to become a victorious person. These people do whatever is possible to reach their goals. Second of all, a competent leader is someone who exhibits determination. Determination is the willpower to complete any task at hand to the very end. This trait is crucial to a leader because aids them with their competence. Lastly, a leader always conveys their integrity with what they do. Integrity is the ability to stay true to oneself and honest with others. Leaders must be integral because honesty is important for a good character and one who will have others look up to them. Furthermore, I believe I display these leadership traits because I am a responsible student with excelling grades in my classes. I take the initiative to take college courses to better my knowledge and participate in extracurricular activities to help me think about my future. Strong students take the initiative to better their education. Though extracurricular activities are optional, strong students take those opportunities to further their knowledge and skills to their very best. Strong students are leaders because of their competency, honesty and integrity, and determination. Without determination, most would not have good character, therefore not making strong students or leaders.
12
In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
SPEAKHIRE will help me boost my own academic profile because the program allows one to assuredly begin to think about their future and learn from people in their dream professions. Not only is one able to become more aware of their own developing skills as a leader in their academic life, but I?m also able to be a open-minded individual and learn more things for myself. With SPEAKHIRE I am able to advance my communication skills because it is up to me to advocate for myself and ask my champion about career pathways. These are all valuable skills for future jobs, internships, and endeavors and to be able to learn that for free is a very valuable thing.
13
In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
Though in my community, there is a lack of opportunities for people in my community to be exposed to career options, the selection of majors in colleges are expanding. In WHEELS last year we had a career day. In the community WHEELS is located in, my community of Washington Heights, a lot of low-income immigrant families live. This career day, made by Futures Ignite, made me familiar with a spectrum of different career paths one would take. Opportunities like these help young people coming from immigrant families realize they can become someone greater than themselves. In other families, there is a chain of either doctor's, lawyers or other professions, but immigrant families' youth do not have resources from their families so events like Career day help a lot.
14
In 250 ? 500 words, why you would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE for your grade at your school. If you do not meet all the requirements, explain why we should consider you for the position.
I believe I would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador for my grade at my school because I am willing to become someone others can rely on. Not only by participating in my own sessions with my champions but I will also be able to help those who are in my foundational year and that is someone I aspire to be. I am excited to mentor my fellow colleagues to further their knowledge of their desired career paths. I am also excited to be able to advance my communication skills by sending things like reminders to my peers. Secondly, I am eager to improve my management skills and learn from my leader's curriculum. Management is a crucial skill to have when I am older and doing my own work and with management, I am able to become a better leader for my peers. By being a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador I am able to connect with my peers in a professional setting which I am not able to do so regularly. This activity will help me in the future when I have co-workers and bosses. Furthermore, due to SPEAKHIRE?s goal ?Developing the social and cultural capital of diverse young people to become leaders in the workforce,? I am confident that I will be able to lead and support my peers through this foundational year. I will be eager to participate in and analyze the information given to me in my leadership curriculum which will help me learn and practice leadership skills and abilities. I am excited to become someone others can rely on and I am able to communicate better as a whole in this role.
15
List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
Though I am not aware of what I will be doing next school year in the 12th grade, this school year I am in multiple programs. Currently, I am in Work Based Learning (WBL) which has similar goals as SPEAKHIRE. It ends around next year, 2023 in January. Every Thursday after school I have to work from 4-6 pm. On Mondays, I have NHS meetings after school. On Tuesdays, I have therapy after school, and Wednesdays I have art club, but that can be changed. On Fridays, I have the 3rd hour of my WBL job and then I am free around 3:00. My schedule fluctuates and is not set in stone, therefore I can definitely switch up some things to be able to meet up with my Champions!
16
Outline your main responsibilities as a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador:
As a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador, I am expected to lead and to support my peers through this foundational year. I will be expected to participate in and analyze the information given to me in my leadership curriculum which will help me learn and practice leadership skills and abilities. Also as an ambassador, I will be responsibly reaching out to fellow interns to remind them of upcoming sessions, either by email, phone, or text. I will keep track of all my communications and will be responsible for reaching the interns and making sure they attend their Internship sessions.

column299: Joining this program is important to me beacuse it takes me one step forward to my future job and helps me get ready for a future career. It will expand my knowledge about potential career paths. Joining this program will help me get ready for a career and give me that push to keep on going and to never give up. This is not only important to me but also my famliy because they didn't have the opportunity I have now. This would be a good opportunity to join this program so I can show my parents that anything is possible when you try and push yourself and to never give up on your dreams. This program will bring me one step forward to making my dream come true to be a police officer and to protect my family but also the community. This program is the accountability I need to show up for myself and my future. This program will help me with my journey to my future career because it takes me a step forward to getting there. I will learn about the process of applying to a job and interviewing skills. I would like to learn more about working in a professional environment. Specifically, I would like to learn more about the police officer training program as well as any books or websites that would have more information about becoming a police officer. I would also like to learn about other potential careers that might involve working with children. I have worked with elementary school students and I enjoyed that work so I would like to learn about career paths that involve working with children. I want to empower children the way I have been empowered by teachers and other mentors in my life. Some tools I hope to learn through this program that I need in order to feel successful in my future career are communication skills, basic understanding of professional workplace operations and time management skills.I will make a commitment to showing up to the program, on time and consistently. I will be an active listener and I will be attentive and engaged in the learning process. I will ask questions and if I am struggling, I will self advocate and ask for help. I will be respectful of my peers and teachers and I will show gratitude for what I am learning. I will be honest with myself and with others if I am struggling and need help. I will stay focused and respect the time the program leaders are taking to help us. I will support my peers and encourage them through this process and work collaboratively with them when necessary. I will share my knowledge and strength and speak up when necessary and also know when it is time to listen. I will show up with an open-mind and will commit to being a curious learner. I will be open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism so I can grown and learn.

column299: I believe this program will give me an opportunity to learn about the steps ahead of high school and college. Many don?t know exactly what we would like to do after high school or what we would like to study in college. With this program, I will be able to start my career journey at an early age. I get to be inspired by others that have been through challenges and overcome those challenges. Hearing about the mistakes they made in school will make me less fearful and more confident in doing things, since I would learn more about what to expect and how to prepare. This program is also important to me because it will make me more confident in what I want to do for a lifetime career since the mentors will guide me how to pursue my hopes and dreams and how to push through challenges in high school and college since it could get very stressful. Additionally, having successful mentors tell me about their experience during their toughest years in school would really help me and inspire me to do more than what I just want for my future success. Overall, joining this program will help me learn from others? mistakes and be more confident about what I want to do after college and what I want to study for in the near future.Joining this program will help me become a doctor by learning from mistakes the mentors made during their school career. Additionally they can help me with time management when it comes to a variety of assignments due and when I become a doctor. Finally, the mentors can guide me with what medical school looks like or how college is and the opportunities there are that I can be aware of so I can make the right decisions for pursuing my dream. Overall, using what I already know and what I can learn from mentors can help me to help others to be just as powerful as I am.

Through this program, I could also make connections that could possibly help move me forward and start a network of people I can rely on as I advance in my career.

column299: Joining the Speak Hire program is important to me because it will help me and give me certain advantages when choosing a career in the future. This is a perfect opportunity for me. I take my future very seriously, I like to plan ahead, and I am open-minded when it comes to my future. The Speak Hire program can also help me feel prepared for the process of finishing high school, entering college, and pursuing a career after. I understand that anything can happen, so the Speak Hire program can provide guidance in dealing with unexpected challenges. I like asking questions, and because picking a career can be very stressful due to how important it is, asking questions to a professional who has already chosen their career will make choosing a career for myself way easier and less stressful. In the future I don?t want to switch careers all the time, I want to know exactly what I want to do so that I don?t waste time because time is money, and time is valuable. 2. The Speak Hire program will help my journey towards my future career by giving me valuable information about specific careers. There is a wide variety of careers out there that I am interested in like becoming a computer engineer and an airline pilot, but I don?t know what these careers are actually like, or if I want to do something else. A mentor can help me get more understanding of what careers are out there, or if these are good careers for me. I already have job experience, so I know what working feels like. I know how to communicate my thoughts in a professional way and I know how to run a successful business. From my experience, there are things I learned that I?d like to see in my future career, I know there is information in different career fields that can only be accessed through connections. I hope the Speak Hire program can teach me about information that is often hidden from the public. The Speak Hire program takes away the stress from the whole process of choosing a career and would be very important and useful to me and my future. 3. I will prove to everyone, my school, my Career Pathways Champions, and the Speak Hire team that I am committed to my own learning and will graduate from the program successfully by attending the Speak Hire program every time it is in session, and I will ask a lot of questions and take notes about the information I learn so I can use it in the future. This is a good opportunity so I will use it because I have not been in a program like this before, and it will help me and my future career so I will take this very seriously and be committed and dedicated to finishing and graduating from the program successfully. I have other commitments inside and outside of school like, the National Honor Society that I am a part of, taking care of my little sister, and a job at an Auto Repair shop. But, I will be sure to balance and organize everything and make more than enough time to participate in the Speak Hire program.

column299: Joining this program is important to me because I get to learn more information about the career that I want to study. I want to learn about the classes they took to get to the job that they got, the credits that they have to earn, and college suggestions. Since I was a little girl I used to think about being a pediatrician, but I've learned more about myself and noticed how I?m capable of doing bigger things. That was when I thought about being a nurse. I was all-in to being a nurse; I was planning on going to college for nursing and taking all nursing-related classes. But I realized that every time I set a goal for myself, I tend to do everything I can to achieve it, and so I told myself I could do even more and become a doctor. Since then, I?ve wanted to become a doctor, and I am thinking about situations where I could be helping someone who is going through something. This program can help me achieve these dreams, and I can learn the steps I would need to take to help people around me and save lives. -It would help my journey towards my future career because I get to have more experience and learn more about the job. I will be able to know more about being a doctor from a person that has personal experience and become more aware of what I need to do to be prepared for college, the credits that I need, and the programs I need to join. It would help me keep my goals more organized and clear. Speaking with a mentor weekly, will help me get to know more about what to put in my goals list while trying to reach that career. It would also help me be certain if that's the career I want to go for since I would be hearing someone else's personal experiences. I want to be able to get the information I need and ask specific questions to see what it is like and if that's exactly what I want to be. The Speak Hire program would keep me on track to thinking about different careers if I don't want to be that and discover more interests outside of the medical field. -A way I could prove to everyone that I will graduate from the program is by successfully balancing all the different programs I am involved with. I currently have a job, I have been volunteering for the last three months, and I am also in the National Honor Society (NHS). While this is a lot on my plate, I will organize my schedule so no events will conflict with each other, and I will attend every weekly mentoring session. I will push myself every day to keep my grades at an average of 80-90 while focusing on the programs I am in as well. If it goes down, I will push myself every day and communicate with my mentor to find the best ways to bring it back up. I also am the person who goes up to someone who is teaching me. I tend to ask as many questions as I need to be able to do a good job, and I push myself as much as I need to in order to succeed.

column299: I?ve always loved trying new things and finding what I?m good at and discovering the things I?m not so great at. With the ones I?m not great in I have always tried to improve either by doing research or acting it out, but regardless of if I started out good at it or bad, if these interests were repetitive, I would get tired and uninterested in them. This made me realize that I would need to find something really exciting for my future career, something that would keep me interested enough that I would enjoy and stick with. Through this program and speaking with career mentors, I want to expand on my knowledge of what I could pursue after high school. Even though people have told me that it?s too early to think about a dream job and how college is going to look like, how I have more than a year to figure it out, and how I can always change my career, I want to be able to say confidently that I have picked the field I see myself doing in the future without having to doubt if I?m sticking with it for the long term or not.How will it help your journey towards your future career?As I got older my dreams changed to new things, I never stuck to one thing for too long. I soon realized that at one point in my life going to have to make a choice on one thing that I actually want to pursue. When I was younger I had many dreams all at once I wanted to be a Model, Doctor, Dancer, etc., but I have recently found my new passion. I want to become an Ultrasound Technician for various reasons, the main one being because I got to see how they work first hand. That experience made me picture myself in the position she was in and how confident she looked at doing what she choose, and that was the exact way I saw myself. Therefore I recognize the importance of programs like Speak Hire, where I can connect with other professionals directly on their experiences. I?ll be able to ask questions on how the process went, how the workplace feels, and if they feel happy with the decision they made on pursuing that career. This program is important to me because it would allow me to learn about this profession and solidify my new career choice.-How will you prove to everyone (your school, your Career Pathways Champions, SPEAKHIRE team, to yourself) that you are committed to your own learning and will graduate from the program successfully? I will prove to everyone that I am committed to my own learning and will graduate from the program successfully by setting a goal for myself to be open to growth and development throughout my time in the program. I demonstrate my commitment by following the expectations of the program such as attending every meeting on time, always being prepared to start my day, and asking further questions I may have. I am always striving for new knowledge and next steps. I'm reminding myself of my one desire, finding a field that I can be committed to the most and knowing what to expect after high school and college. I recognize how this opportunity is something many people won?t have, and that this will benefit me in answering the question that speaks to my future and education. I would prove to myself that I?m being committed to my education by showing interest in the topic either by saying what I?m concerned about when it comes to the career or being interactive, which can bring you many other opportunities/knowledge.

11
In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
I have 3 qualities that make me a leader and a good student. These qualities are such as responsibility, balance and honesty. I am primarily responsible to myself, I try to be responsible for my actions and words, and in general for my existence. And I am also aware of my responsibility to my family, I try to help and provide support both morally and materially. But I also have an understanding of responsibility to society and the close circle of communication in which I am, responsibility in the form of assistance to those in need, and compliance with the request in an appropriate manner. However, there is another important quality that helps me spiritually, such as balance. Thanks to it, despite obstacles and external factors, I can control myself and go to my goal, as well as be respectful to others in a particular society. I always try to be mindful in dealing with my feelings and rational with my challenges . Finally, the quality of a person that may eventually disappear in everyday life is honesty. It is important for me to be honest first of all with myself, whether I bring things to the end, how honestly I did it and whether this or that choice suits me. In addition, it is important for me to be honest with people who trust me. In conclusion, I would say that these qualities help me earn trust among people close to me, as well as help to achieve success in my studies.
12
In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
I assume that at Speakhire I will be able to improve my academic profile. I will be able to gain new knowledge in various fields of activity and apply this knowledge in the future. It will help me to gain the experience that I need when I get my first job , and develop my existing skills to become more capable in the next step of my life. Moreover, I think that with Speakhire ,I will improve my skills such as teamwork, being organized and a great leader. In conclusion, I would like to say that with Speakhire I will be able to get an advantage that will definitely be taken into account when entering a higher educational institution.
13
In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
I think for immigrants who are interested in a successful career in the United States, they need to participate in various programs where they teach skills in a particular field of activity and can practice in different directions. And also, it would be nice to get acquainted with a career in the school curriculum, and visit different educational institutions and get acquainted with the subjects taught there. To the above, you can also add the opportunity to participate in volunteer events, where you can learn different skills and qualities such as behavior in society, leadership skills, responsibility and a little idea about careers. Well, in the end, in this way you can decide what suits you best.
14
In 250 ? 500 words, why you would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE for your grade at your school. If you do not meet all the requirements, explain why we should consider you for the position.
Speakhire will help and assist me in my academic and career choices . Joining Speakhire will boost my knowledge and put me at advantage while making informed decisions about my next step in life . After all, it is here that I can broaden my horizons and meet experienced professionals in a particular job and can learn different skills from them and get useful tips for a successful career. However, I expect that by enrolling in this program I will improve my leadership skills and practice effective communication and building meaningful and productive relationships. As well as eventually understanding what profession and what career path suits me and matches with my interests and skills . It will give me a better understanding of the job market and careers ecosystems in my new community. And I can just get pleasant emotions from meeting and communicating with new people and classmates. In addition to this, it is Speakhire that helps immigrant students to explore colleges, various potential paths from college to a good career, which is also important for me. I am looking forward to hearing about the education pathways to different careers and jobs so I start preparing myself. However, it is worth noting that in Speakhire I will also be able to improve my level of English and communication skills .In conclusion, I would say that I see a lot of benefits for myself in particular as I am eager to learn about careers since day one I moved to this country as well developing skills of leadership and communication which is so essential for successful careers on the future.
15
List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
In the upcoming academic year, my schedule includes schooling 5 days a week, the other 2 days off I work part-time. For Speakhire, I will spend as much time as I need, but at the moment, according to the schedule, I have 1 hour a week for classes at Speakhire.
16

Help Interns achieve success and provide support, and keep track of their attendance.

Ambassador Response: 
10
In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
?A genuine leader is not a searcher for consensus but a molder of consensus?. --Martin Luther King Jr. Being the oldest sibling in my household, I have always set out to be a leader and to set an example to being a strong student . I enjoy taking on leadership roles and going out of my way to assist and guide others. One way i would describe myself is determined. An example of that is by being one of the DECA leaders at George Washington high school. As a DECA leader, I have helped many students including my teammates to win competitions and make it onto states where we are able to compete with thousands of students from all over Pennsylvania even though that was one of the most difficult challenges I faced. Another way I have had the opportunity to serve as a leader is being the secretary for the class of 2022. As the secretary, I have helped plan some events such as movie night virtually but due to the pandemic we haven?t been able to do much but I hope when we are able to go back to school that I can take on my role more. Moreover, as a member of the Peer Group Connection, I mentored freshmen students on how to successfully navigate their first year of school. Lastly, over the years, I have grown to be a well-rounded student. While doing excellently in my academics, I keep a part time job and play on the lacrosse team in school. My engagement in these extracurricular activities have helped me to hone my ability to work in teams to achieve a set goal. I believe that being an ambassador will provide an enabling environment for me to grow as a leader while working collaboratively with my peers to make an impact in our school and society.
11
In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
Speakhire can help me boost my own academic profile by helping me gain opportunities and going out of my way to teach others how to help and guide people. It can also help my academic profile because it can also teach me skills for when I get to college.
12
In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
As a daughter of immigrant parents, I have always been a go-getter. My whole life has been about taking opportunities and helping others. Whether that be helping friends with personal problems or something as simple as assignments I am someone that they can count on. Leadership is something that comes naturally to me as well as seizing opportunities
13
In 250 ? 500 words, why you would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE for your grade at your school. If you do not meet all the requirements, explain why we should consider you for the position.
I would succeed as a speakhire for my grade at my school because I would be able to give back to the people I see every day and make my classroom a better place. Growing and expanding my leadership roles will help me especially in the future career path of being in finance. I am a woman with many goals in life, growing up goals are what kept me motivated to be as far in life as I am right now. Both short-term and long-term goals have not only helped me grow but allowed me to achieve things I didn?t think were possible. I am not afraid of trying new things and working with people
14
List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
Some classes I?m taking this year is accounting and finance 2, IB history, and pgc. I am also in cheer and have a a part time job. I also plan on playing lacrosse later on in the school year. I am available to work with speakhire on my days off from work. I work Sunday- Tuesday most days.
15
Outline your main responsibilities as a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador:
To lead and inspire other students

11
In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
I think I am a good leader since I like to help people a lot in whatever I can help them, such as finding order in tasks, I also consider myself a very kind, friendly and tolerant person to help at all times, I also like things go well and I always like to have discipline in everything I do.
12
In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
I believe that this program will help me to use my knowledge more and learn from others that I do not know, it will also help me in a personal and professional future.
13
In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
Young immigrants and new to the country do not always receive the same help, since everything depends on the immigration case of the people. Sometimes they have many job and academic opportunities, since they always ask for social security, something that not all young immigrants have. When they see the need they have, they don't know which way to go, but if the young people are helped with time, this bad destiny may change one for the better, since most young people leave their country to be able to improve themselves.
14
In 250 ? 500 words, why you would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE for your grade at your school. If you do not meet all the requirements, explain why we should consider you for the position.
I think that speakhire would help me a lot academically since it would give me skills and open up new opportunities, but if I do not meet the requirements, I will not be able to know if the skills that will help me in the future.
15
List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
The classes that I will take next year I do not know explicitly, what I do know is that I will take English classes, I plan to dedicate my time in speakhire approximately once a week on Mondays approximately all day, I will be able to dedicate an hour taking time every day if possible.
16
Outline your main responsibilities as a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador:
I understand that in order to be a good ambassador I have to help all the people who are inside or interested in SPEAKHIRE, as I also know that I have to help my main advisor in everything I can with my colleagues.

In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
I am the best option for the open ambassador position within the SPEAKHIRE Foundation. I say this because I am an excellent communicator, accountable and reliable, and I am self-motivated. I believe these traits make me the best candidate for this position.
I am an excellent and effective communicator. I think the first step to becoming a good communicator is to first be a good listener. Through listening to what others have to say and really paying attention to their problems and issues one way can find the best way to help them. I feel this is what makes me a good communicator and an even better leader; I listen before taking action.
I am accountable and reliable. If something needs to get done I?m the person you can call knowing that it?s going to be done. I take my responsibilities seriously and ensure that they are all completed to perfection. I hold myself accountable for all of my responsibilities. If something is not done on time or incorrectly I ensure to look back on my mistakes and improve to do better in the future. I am efficient, effective, and work quickly. All things that are required of a good leader and team-player.
I am very self-motivated. I never give up on my goals and I am constantly working to improve. I keep going even if I am faced with challenges and things changing. I am a quick thinker and am able to think of solutions in any situation.
I am the best choice for this position because I am a motivated, excellent communicator, accountable, reliable, and self-motivated. I am diligent and a team-player. I believe that through these qualities I will be an excellent ambassador.

In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
I believe that SPEAKHIRE can help boost my academic profile. It is a valuable resource that connects me to people within my chosen career. SPEAKHIRE also opens up doors for other internships to become available. It is a resource that I am glad I had the opportunity to partake in.
Through SPEAKHIRE I have been given a mentor who helps me with my college and university planning. They guide me through the process and show me what the field is like. They are helping to prepare me for the future and that is an opportunity I am grateful for.
I have also been exposed to various internships within my field. Through SPEAKHIRE and with the help of my mentor I have been able to apply to various internships. This has also helped to prepare me for job searching in the future.
SPEAKHIRE has and continues to help me with my chosen career path. It has helped me meet professionals within the said career and introduce me to internship opportunities. These relations help me both now and in the future.

In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
Immigrants and first-generation Americans can gain awareness of career opportunities through organizations like SPEAKHIRE. Through schools, community programs, and religious activities. These organizations tend to have limited space, funds, and outreach.
Many immigrants and first-generation Americans have little opportunity to gain knowledge about various careers. As many opportunities are not easily accessible. These organizations may also not have the best options as many lack the funds needed.
These organizations may also have a lack of outreach. Many industries run on a who knows who basis. Many professionals are more willing to give opportunities to people they already know. These organizations are mainly run by volunteers or individuals who may not have many connections within the industry. Although they try their best these organizations are of little to no help to most of the children attending.

In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
I am a student who is trying to do the work on time, because I think being punctual is not a hard thing to do, but not everyone does it. Also I believe that being punctual is a way of respecting our friends, teachers, and family. I am also a student who is helping others when my classmates are behind. I think it is so important that we help each other, and cooperate with each other as a group. That way we can make a better result and get to know each other. In addition, I am a student who is optimistic every time. Being optimistic is always better than having a sad face everyday. It is also how I am being unique than others. Being optimistic can make others feel good and myself. Whenever I face a problem, I'm not just give up. I am always trying to find a way to solve the problem and seeking help from teachers or friends.

In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
I think the major things that Speakhire can help me is to improve my leadership skills and find my interest and passion about my future career. I am seeking my answers in this program and also the reason I participate in this program. Also I don't really know the colleges that fit my career, so exploring different colleges that fit my career is another thing that Speakhire can help me with.

In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
I think the young people gain their awareness of career opportunities from parents, social media, school, and research. I think there are not many young people that have a strong mind of what they really want to be, and not being aware of their career opportunities. So most of the time they do what others want them to be instead of really asking themselves. It is also applying to me. But there are also the young people who follow their own interest to choose the career they want to be.

In 250 ? 500 words, why you would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE for your grade at your school. If you do not meet all the requirements, explain why we should consider you for the position.
I would succeed as a Speakhire for my grade at my school, because I would learn more about my career and by that I would know what grade I still need improve to go to the college that fit my career, and also learn about the subjects that are related to my career so that I can pay extra attention at those classes. I would have the inspiration to improve my grade, because before I just wanted to get a good grade to make my parents happy, but by that time I would have the motivation to get a good grade and improve myself.

List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
I have a college now precalculus class every Monday and Wednesday, after school activities on Tuesday. So, I would like to spend my Thursday and Friday for 2 hours a week at Speakhire.

I will take the responsibilities of helping each other, trying my best and participating in all the meetings as a Speakhire Ambassador.

  • In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
    I believe that speakhire can help me improve my academic profile because I will be working with professional and trained people who will guide and teach me everything necessary to achieve my goal. Also, I believe that the activities and meetings will be very professional, and I feel that the activities and assignments will help me develop new skills and also improve the ones I already have. I remember from the meeting to introduce Speakhire that they mentioned that we will be able to speak with people who are specialized in the career that interests us and I think that will help a lot because they are people who already study and they know what is necessary to be in a high level and how hard we have to work to reach that level. Finally, I feel that after speakhire people will be able to notice that I improved and that will let people know that I've worked hard and that speakhire does help people to be successful and gives us the right tools to be successful in the future.
  • n 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
    I believe that the greatest opportunity young immigrants and Americans have to learn about career opportunities is school. Based on my experience, the school gives us a lot of help either to discover what career we want to study or to know the steps we have to follow, in addition to providing us with information about programs or people that can help us to facilitate our path until we decide which career choose or until we are professionals in a career. In addition, we have the internet which can be a great source of information for anything we need. For example, we can search for information about the career that interests us and thus learn more about it and determine whether we like it or not. In the same way, we can look for more options until we discover the one that we really like or are interested in.
  • In 250 ? 500 words, why you would succeed as a SPEAKHIRE for your grade at your school. If you do not meet all the requirements, explain why we should consider you for the position.
    I believe that I would be successful as a speakhire for my grade at my school because from what I have seen and heard, the program offers very good tools for the development of our skills, in addition to having trained people who can help me improve and improve discover new skills. If I don't meet all the requirements the reason why I should be consider for the position is because I know that if you allow me to show what I'm capable of, I'm sure that I can do better and put a lot of effort until I reach the required level to be part of speakhire. Also, I know I can be good in different ways, I can also help others to improve because I like to encourage them and motivate them so they can keep studying and do their best so they can be successful in the future. Also, I think it could help me to be better and develop new skill to be more professional and be prepared for the future.
  • List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
    The upcoming year I will be taking the mandatory classes like Science, Math, English and History. Also, depending on whether we go back to class or not, I would like to participate in the basketball team again, as well as participate in computer science class or in a club like Latino club or photography. I will have the schedule determined by the teachers which already has a set time for each task and after my mandatory assignments I will dedicate all the time necessary to do the best possible work at Speakhire.

In 250 ? 500 words, describe three traits which make you a leader and a strong student.
I consider myself a strong student and leader. There are no specific characteristics of a leader, I think that everyone is a leader in a certain way. In my case, I consider myself a leader because I have these certain abilities which are the following; Communication must operate in two directions: expressing ideas, instructions and opinions clearly and assertively, as well as ensuring that the message is heard and understood. The ability to listen and take into account all the opinions, individual and collective, that come to me is also typical of a leader. Capacity for planning and development; When I have set goals, it is essential to draw up a plan to achieve them. This plan must plan all the actions that must be carried out, the times, the people who will carry them out, the resources that will be used. I try to find new and better ways to do the activities. This trait is essential in the context of a society that advances at a forced march, with constant changes in technology, communications, and high competitiveness. I am responsible, I am aware that my position in the group gives me power, and I know how to use it to benefit the group. It is not selfish; I use my position to activate processes and energize potentials.
11
In 100 ? 250 words, how can SPEAKHIRE help you you boost your own academic profile?
SPEAK HIRE can help me with my academic profile because this project is based on helping young students who are not sure of their future, so they advise, help and answer your questions about high school, university, and professional careers. For example, last year I acquired many skills that helped me in my academic profile. One of them is; 1-Improve my progress in English. 12
In 100 ? 250 words, what opportunities do young people who are immigrant and first-generation American currently have to gain awareness of career opportunities?
The opportunities that young immigrants and first-generation Americans have to know professional opportunities are equal, that is, they both have the same opportunities to learn, it does not matter if they have little time in this country, they all have the opportunity to choose what they want to be in the future, to the same with first-generation Americans.
13

SPEAK HIRE is a very good opportunity for me because it will help me in my academic future, my future university, and my future professional career. I will succeed as SPEAKHIRE in my grade at school because I am responsible. Leadership ability, I can learn to collaborate and work together to achieve the same goals and motivate each other to move forward. Verbal and written communication. Ability to solve problems. Communicating effectively, and with respect, begins with the understanding and use of simple words, gestures, and expressions so that all of this is later used in written communication.
14
List the classes you will be taking the upcoming school year and any other activities which will keep you occupied. Please explain to us how many hours a week you will dedicate towards SPEAKHIRE and what your schedule will look like.
-I would attend my normal classes that start from 8:20 to 2:40 (and about 30 minutes on the way home) I would also attend after-school every Tuesday starting at 2:40 and ending at 4:00.
15
Outline your main responsibilities as a SPEAKHIRE Ambassador:
-Attend all SPEAKHIRE meetings. -Help my classmates. - Meet all guidelines

Essay 1

What does it mean to be a leader? What makes a person a great leader? A leader is someone who commands and leads a group. It?s those traits that enables people to trust and follow that person that every leader should possess. The traits that makes me a leader and a strong student are persuasion, open mind and great communication.
One of my special trait is persuasion. I believe I am great at persuasion. I can persuade people giving them examples, facts and ideas. Usually I persuade my friends to do what I want them to. For example I often persuade my friends to go shopping with me or to go out with me on the weekends.
Another one of my strong trait is being open minded. I believe being open to new ideas is a must for a leader. I?m very open minded. I listen to other people?s opinions and take them into the picture. 
My final and mainly used trait is communication. I think every leader should have communication skills. Whether you have an official management role or informally lead a work group or team, effective communication skills are essential to your success in a leadership position. A good communication leads to building strong relationships and success.
In conclusion, as I stated before, the traits that makes me a leader and a strong student are persuasion, open mind and great communication. These traits are my strong points and they help me in everything.



Essay 2

Speak Mentorship can help me boost my own academic profile in many ways. It can help me be more outspoken since I?m kinda shy sometimes. It gives experience to members in  many things. It also helps me awareness of career opportunities. These knowledges will end up helping me a lot in the future especially after high school. Also, since colleges look at records The fact that I was in this program might look good in my records too.

Essay 3

Currently young woman who are first generation American have many opportunities to gain awareness of career opportunities especially the ones who still attend high school. There are many programs at schools that can helps them with this.  For example in my school there?s the Speak Program for girls. This program helps us gain more information about the careers that we are interested in. I learned a lot of things about career opportunities since I joined this program.


Essay 4

I would succeed as a SPEAK Mentorship Ambassador for my grade at my school for many reasons. The main reason being that I meet all the requirements. Also because I?m a strong student and have the traits, persuasion, open mindedness and great communication. I believe these traits would help a lot if I was to become the ambassador.

Essay 5

Currently I?m interested in many career opportunities. However I haven?t decided what I want to pursue. The career fields that I?m interested in are medical field, business field, multilingual field, and law field. 
I decided I wanted to pursue these fields because these are fields that I?m interested in and enjoy a lot.  I chose my career field interests based on my interests. Mostly I?m interested in these fields because all these fields gives me a chance to help others. I like helping people and I really like to be useful to others. I like the feeling of being needed by someone.
 I think that medical field is really interesting and important. Doctors have the ability and knowledge to lessen pain and save people from dying. The reason I like this field is because when I was a kid my grandma died right in front of me and all I could do was watch and cry. At that time I really wished I was a doctor and could save my grandma. 
I?m also interested in jobs in business fields such as lawyer. Lawyers help people by saving an innocent person from going to jail with proves. There are many lawyers out there who only go after the large money and try to hide the truth but there are also good lawyers. 
Multilingual field is really good too. Multilingual jobs include being an interpreter or a translator. Multilingual people help others connect by translating for them. The first time I came to U.S I didn?t know English so I suffered a little bit. Thanks god there were these girls in my class who spoke my language, Uzbek, and they helped me know what people around me were saying.
